summary.text: Mark Gamba is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 41, which includes Milwaukie, Oak Grove and parts of Southeast Portland, who has served since January 9, 2023, and is seeking re-election in November 2026.
He previously served as mayor of Milwaukie.

paragraphs.text: Mark Gamba was born in Fort Collins, Colorado, graduated from Glenwood Springs High School in 1977, and earned an associate degree in photography from Colorado Mountain College in 1979.
His career experience includes working as a commercial photographer, photojournalist and small business owner.
Gamba served on the Milwaukie City Council from 2012 to 2015 and was elected mayor of Milwaukie on May 19, 2015.
He has also served as vice chair of the League of Oregon Cities' Subcommittee on Energy and Environment.
He succeeded Karin Power in the Oregon House.
On his legislative website, Gamba writes that he represents Milwaukie, Oak Grove, northern Clackamas County, and the Sellwood, Eastmoreland and Woodstock neighborhoods of Portland.
He is on the 2026 general election ballot with Democratic and Working Families Party nominations.
